issues.source_excerpt:
I2.1.2.2 The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the
            upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.
issues.reason: The query reports a violation only when a case numeric value is greater than DUI. It does not report a violation when DUI is greater than the greatest applicable case value, so it does not enforce equality between DUI and the greatest displacement. The comparison is numeric and unit-filtered, but one-sided.
issues.expected: The active constraint must reject both DUI below the greatest determining-case numeric value and DUI above it, while retaining the declared decimal and metric-kilotonne checks.
issues.suggestion: Replace the one-sided greater-than test with aggregate/equality logic that requires no determining case to exceed DUI and requires DUI to equal the maximum determining-case numeric value. Compare declared numeric values, not quantity RDF terms.
